profile.title: President Message
profile.intro: Combining IT and business to create value beyond the traditional trading-company model.
profile.name: Wataru Iijima, Representative Director
message: Thank you for your continued support of Wakyou Trading Co., Ltd.
Guided by our philosophy, “Connecting trust. Creating value,” we continue to walk alongside our clients as a bridge between Japan and the world.

International trade and cross-border e-commerce are changing rapidly as digital technology advances and new business models emerge. Through trading, wholesale and retail, cross-border EC, EC operations, trade consulting, live commerce and creator-business consulting, we provide solutions tailored to each client’s needs.

My background is in information technology, including system development and network technology. I believe combining IT and business enables us to create value beyond the traditional boundaries of a trading company.
Trust is the foundation of every business. We approach every project with integrity and remain committed to delivering long-term value.
profile.bio: Born in 1999. Studied information technology with a focus on IT, networks and software development, earning qualifications in Java programming, networking and databases. Today, he leads Wakyou Trading and works to develop international trading, cross-border e-commerce and digital business models connecting Japan with overseas markets.
personal: Researching IT, AI and emerging technology
profile.motto: Trust is the starting point of every business.
